positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Achieved certification in MEAN Stack technologies via a two month training program using MongoDB, Express, Angular, and Node.js.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a team of 7 interns and 4 engineers to design and develop a fully functional mobile application from scratch using React Native
• Worked cross-functionally with a project manager and multiple UI/UX designers on project requirements and final design for the application
• Quickly learned new tools such as React Native, SQLite, REST API, Postman, Redux, and Salesforce within 2 weeks in order to effectively work on the new mobile application
• Developed over 80% of the mobile application’s user interface utilizing the React Native framework while storing and fetching data using Redux and SQLite queries
• Implemented REST API calls to communicate with external devices and servers
• Conducted an internal project presentation and multiple usability tests in order to gather feedback
positions.insights: React Native, Mobile Application Development and +2 skills

positions.title: Salesforce Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Gained professional experience on building my career and establishing a personal brand
• Connected with industry professionals to learn more about the technology industry and develop skills in entrepreneurship
• Gained experience with the Salesforce platform and Apex coding via Salesforce Trailhead
• Assisted professional data analysts in analyzing large customer datasets
• Leveraged the Salesforce platform to visualize big data sets for internal presentations

projects.title: Paws Pet N' Track
projects.description:
• Designed and developed a mobile application for employees and customers of Paws Pet N’ Play to improve business management efficiency by over 50% by providing a solution to managing customer packages
• Utilized tools such as Android Studio, Java, SQLite, and Firebase to develop the application’s user interface and backend server
• Utilized Figma to design the application’s user interface while maintaining clear communication with management about project requirements and quality

projects.title: Hydro Hero
projects.description:
• Lead a team of 4 developers in designing, developing, and testing an Android application that allows users to track their water consumption, view their hydration history, and receive hydration reminders
• Utilized tools such as Android Studio, Java, SQLite, Firebase, and Agile practices
• Connected the mobile application to Google Firebase to enable user accounts
• Created and maintained the application’s local database with SQLite
